name: 08077 · Cinnaminson, NJ
findings: ZIP 08077 (Cinnaminson) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08077 (Cinnaminson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08077 (Cinnaminson) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
